evals.name: create-fresh-webp-cli
evals.prompt: I'm building a small CLI tool that watches a folder and automatically converts any image dropped into it to WebP. Write me a PRD for it. Save it wherever makes sense.
evals.expected_output: A prd.md with hierarchical numbered sections, requirements phrased as capabilities (not implementation), concise, short overview at top.

evals.name: reject-impl-leak-url-shortener
evals.prompt: Write a PRD for a URL shortener service. It should use Postgres with a base62 encoding table and put a Redis cache in front of the lookups.
evals.expected_output: PRD states requirements from customer perspective; Postgres/base62/Redis kept out of requirements OR skill asks whether user wants to control those choices before including them. Does not silently bake infra choices in as requirements.

evals.name: drift-catch-mid-implementation
evals.prompt: Here's my existing PRD for the URL shortener (in prd.md). I'm mid-implementation. Let's make the shortened links expire after 24 hours, and also add an endpoint that returns how many times a link has been clicked. Go ahead and implement those.
evals.expected_output: Skill proactively flags that link-expiry changes/contradicts existing behavior and the click-count endpoint is new functionality not in the PRD, and asks whether to update the PRD to stay source of truth. Does NOT silently edit the PRD without asking.
